<style>
:root{
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  --duration:6000ms;
}

.th-faq__item{ transition:transform .45s var(--ease); }

.th-faq__card-media{ display:none; }         
.th-faq__trigger{ background:transparent; }

.th-faq__icon{
  transition:background .4s var(--ease), transform .45s var(--ease);
  position:relative;
}
.th-faq__item[data-active="true"] .th-faq__icon{ transform:rotate(45deg); }

/* ---- раскрытие панели (grid-rows трюк) ---- */
.th-faq__panel{
  display:grid;                 /* ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО для анимации высоты */
  grid-template-rows:0fr;       /* закрытое состояние */
  transition:grid-template-rows .5s var(--ease);
}
.th-faq__item[data-active="true"] .th-faq__panel{ grid-template-rows:1fr; }
.th-faq__panel-inner{ overflow:hidden; }

.th-faq__body{
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .45s var(--ease) .08s;
}
.th-faq__item[data-active="true"] .th-faq__body{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }

/* ---- прогресс ---- */
.th-faq__progress{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
.th-faq__progress-bar{         
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  transform-origin:left center;
  transform:scaleX(0);
}
.th-faq__item[data-active="true"] .th-faq__progress-bar{
  animation:faq-fill var(--duration,6000ms) linear forwards;
}
@keyframes faq-fill{ from{transform:scaleX(0);} to{transform:scaleX(1);} }

/* ---- правая панель ---- */
.th-faq__stage{ flex:1; }
.th-faq__image{
  position:absolute; inset:0;
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .7s var(--ease);
}
.th-faq__image[data-visible="true"]{ opacity:1; }

@media (max-width:1024px){
  .th-faq{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .th-faq__media{ display:none; }        /* превью справа скрыто */
  .th-faq__card-media{ display:flex; }   /* картинка показывается над контентом карточки */
  .th-faq__progress{ display:none; }     /* линия прогресса убрана */
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  function init(){
    var root = document.querySelector('.th-faq');
    if (!root) return;

    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.th-faq__item'));
    if (!items.length) return;

    var stage  = root.querySelector('.th-faq__stage');
    var images = stage ? Array.prototype.slice.call(stage.querySelectorAll('.th-faq__image')) : [];

    var duration = parseInt(root.getAttribute('data-duration'), 10) || 6000;
    var mqStack  = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1024px)');
    var timer    = null;

    // ---- 1) clone each image from the right panel into its card (idempotent) ----
    items.forEach(function(item, i){
      var media    = item.querySelector('.th-faq__card-media');
      var srcLayer = images[i];
      if (!media || !srcLayer) return;
      if (media.querySelector('.th-faq__img, [data-faq__img]')) return; // already cloned
      var img = srcLayer.querySelector('.th-faq__img, [data-faq__img]');
      if (img) media.appendChild(img.cloneNode(true)); // copy as-is, styling stays in your CSS
    });

    // ---- 2) set up the right panel as cross-fading layers ----
    if (stage && images.length){
      var h = images[0].offsetHeight;
      if (getComputedStyle(stage).position === 'static') stage.style.position = 'relative';
      if (h > 0) stage.style.minHeight = h + 'px';
      images.forEach(function(layer, i){
        layer.style.position = 'absolute';
        layer.style.top = layer.style.left = layer.style.right = layer.style.bottom = '0';
        layer.style.transition = 'opacity .6s ease';
        layer.style.opacity = (i === 0) ? '1' : '0';
      });
    }

    function showPreview(index){
      images.forEach(function(l, i){ l.style.opacity = (i === index) ? '1' : '0'; });
    }

    // ---- 3) accordion ----
    function open(index, withTimer){
      items.forEach(function(it, i){
        it.setAttribute('data-active', i === index ? 'true' : 'false'); // drives panel + progress CSS
      });
      showPreview(index);
      if (timer){ clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
      if (withTimer && !mqStack.matches){ // autoslide only on desktop
        timer = setTimeout(function(){ open((index + 1) % items.length, true); }, duration);
      }
    }

    items.forEach(function(item, i){
      // neutralize hash-links so the header click can't jump the page to the top
      Array.prototype.slice.call(item.querySelectorAll('a[href]')).forEach(function(a){
        var hr = a.getAttribute('href');
        if (hr === '#' || (hr && hr.charAt(0) === '#')) a.removeAttribute('href');
      });

      if (!item.__faqBound){           // bind the click handler only once per card
        item.__faqBound = true;
        item.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          if (e && e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
          var isActive = item.getAttribute('data-active') === 'true';
          if (isActive){
            item.setAttribute('data-active', 'false');
            if (timer){ clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
          } else {
            open(i, true);
          }
        });
      }
    });

    open(0, true); // first card open + start the cycle on desktop

    if (!root.__faqMqBound){
      root.__faqMqBound = true;
      mqStack.addEventListener('change', function(){
        var activeIndex = items.findIndex(function(it){ return it.getAttribute('data-active') === 'true'; });
        open(activeIndex < 0 ? 0 : activeIndex, true);
      });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
